problems: The proposed dataset-level checksum_match extended the verified TAR checksum to a review using a family SOFT whose bytes differ from the historical pin. The corrected proposal scopes the TAR match explicitly, uses manual_structure_match for this review and preserves the historical audit’s record.

The cohort description omitted the deposited species label (Rattus rattus, taxon 10117) alongside the paper’s Wistar/Rnor6 description and the registered Rattus norvegicus. It also omitted Phase I pair housing. The animal-to-library request now asks for the earlier cage assignments and species confirmation.

The proposal’s orientation agrees with the workbook, but it dropped the current ledger’s caveat about the paper describing changes relative to CS. The correction identifies the workbook sign for the 430 FDR calls and quantifies how the two published fold thresholds relate to S1 membership.

The criteria named the unresolved cohort while the proposed effects dimension was also limited. The correction distinguishes the shared log2 scale and known direction from the undocumented DESeq2 design and included inputs. It also identifies the registered FDR family separately from the published DE rows.

The replacement comparison spec omitted the registered feature-map pin used to derive its symbol keys. The corrected spec binds that original input by path, size and SHA-256, along with the JATS and current SOFT cited for the cohort. The SOURCES.tsv descriptions of the ten ENA run XMLs imply embedded submitted FILE metadata, although these XMLs contain report links. NCBI SRA supplies the filenames.
